hotel_name: Hotel O Om Villa Residency Near Lotus Temple

negative_snippets: The Worst hotel ever. No neatness, no water facility, fans also don't work properly and the hotel staff were very rude, they are claiming that the online room price is not real and asking for more money

Worst lodge ever stayed.
Also whatever the prices u see on the website were manipulated just before the time of check-in and almost doubled the rent.
Worst staff, not even a single staff person looked responsible.
Worst services.
No water.
U can find healthy cockroaches in your room and bathroom itself.
No proper lock for rooms.
Just the outlook of room seems good but once you enter the room you will come to know the reality.
There was a problem with fan n AC.
No cleanliness, there were cigerette butts.
If you wanted to check out in the morning, there a receptionist sleeping there itself, he will be in his sleep even there is a earthquake outside.

This hotel is not good. The room I booked was not given at the same price — they charged extra. In the morning, at the time of check-out, the person at the reception was sleeping so deeply that even after trying to wake him up for 15 minutes, he didn’t respond. Also, the cleanliness of the room was not maintained at all.
